leadText: Taiiku Okazaki (Japanese: 岡崎体育 Okazaki Taiiku or Okazaki Physical Education) is a Japanese musician who has written and sung various songs for and Pokémon movies, starting in . His real name is Akitoshi Oka (Japanese: 岡亮聡 Oka Akitoshi).
plainText:
Taiiku Okazaki (Japanese: 岡崎体育 Okazaki Taiiku or Okazaki Physical Education) is a Japanese musician who has written and sung various songs for and Pokémon movies, starting in . His real name is Akitoshi Oka (Japanese: 岡亮聡 Oka Akitoshi).

==Biography==
Okazaki was born on July 3, 1989 in , , . He began his musical career in 2012, and made his official debut with the album BASIN TECHNO under in 2016.

==Musical appearances==
Pose (artist, lyricist, composer, and arranger)
Twerp, Twerpette (artist, lyricist, and composer)
Your Adventure (artist, lyricist, and composer)
Notebook of the Heart (lyricist and composer)
The Rule Song (composer and arranger)
(lyricist and composer)
Show Window (artist, lyricist, composer, and arranger)
The Hum of the Forest (composer)
Strange and Wonderful Creatures (lyricist and composer)
I'm Home and Welcome Back (lyricist and composer)
